title: C++ Numbers
description: Doing arithmetic with C++ numbers: <cmath>, limits, integer overflow, floating-point precision and the modern random library.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: 用 C++ 數字做運算：<cmath>、數值極限、整數溢位、浮點精度與現代隨機數程式庫。

questions.prompt: Which function returns the square root of a number?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個函式會回傳數字的平方根？

explanation.zh-Hant: std::sqrt(x) 回傳平方根；pow 是次方，abs 是絕對值，floor 是向下取整。三者都在 <cmath>。

questions.explanation: std::sqrt(x) returns the square root. pow raises to a power, abs returns the absolute value and floor rounds down; all are in <cmath>.

questions.prompt: What range of values does `rand() % 10` produce on a typical implementation?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在典型實作中，`rand() % 10` 會產生哪個範圍的值？

explanation.zh-Hant: 非負整數對 10 取餘數的結果是 0 到 9；若要 1 到 10，需寫 `rand() % 10 + 1`。

questions.explanation: The remainder of a non-negative integer modulo 10 is 0..9. For 1..10 use `rand() % 10 + 1`.

b.zh-Hant: 目前程式中最大的整數變數

c.zh-Hant: 編譯器的最大記憶體用量

explanation.zh-Hant: numeric_limits 提供該型別的極限值；max() 是最大值，min() 是最小值，sizeof 才是位元組數。

options.text: The largest value an `int` can represent
The largest integer variable currently in the program
The size of an int in bytes

questions.explanation: numeric_limits reports limits for a type: max() is its largest value and min() its smallest. The byte size comes from sizeof.

questions.prompt: In IEEE-754 double arithmetic, what is the result of `0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3`?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在 IEEE-754 double 運算中，`0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3` 的結果是甚麼？

a.zh-Hant: 通常為 false，因為二進位無法精確表示 0.1

explanation.zh-Hant: 0.1 與 0.2 在二進位浮點中是循環小數，儲存時已四捨五入；相加結果與 0.3 的表示可能相差一個極小量，因此直接比較通常不成立。

options.text: Usually false, because 0.1 has no exact binary representation

questions.explanation: 0.1 and 0.2 are repeating fractions in binary and are rounded when stored. Their sum can differ from the stored 0.3 by a tiny amount, so a direct equality test is usually false.

questions.prompt: Which of these functions are declared in `<cmath>`? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些函式宣告在 `<cmath>` 中？可多選。

questions.explanation: sqrt, pow and floor are in <cmath>. strlen is declared in <cstring>.

questions.prompt: Which of these belong to the `<random>` library? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些屬於 `<random>` 程式庫？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: mt19937、uniform_int_distribution、random_device 都是 <random> 的組件；std::rand 來自 <cstdlib>，是較舊的 C 介面。

questions.explanation: mt19937, uniform_int_distribution and random_device are all part of <random>. std::rand comes from <cstdlib> and is the older C interface.

questions.prompt: Integer division in C++ truncates toward zero.

prompt.zh-Hant: C++ 的整數除法會向零截斷。

explanation.zh-Hant: C++11 起，整數除法的商向零截斷：-7 / 2 是 -3，而不是 -4；餘數的符號跟隨被除數。

questions.explanation: Since C++11 integer division truncates toward zero: -7 / 2 is -3, not -4, and the remainder takes the sign of the dividend.

questions.prompt: A `float` usually stores more precision than a `double`.

prompt.zh-Hant: `float` 通常比 `double` 儲存更高的精度。

explanation.zh-Hant: double 通常有 53 位有效位元，float 約 24 位；double 精度較高但佔用較多記憶體。

questions.explanation: A double usually has 53 bits of precision and a float about 24. double is more precise but uses more memory.

questions.prompt: The class template that reports the limits of a numeric type is std::numeric____.

prompt.zh-Hant: 用來查詢數值型別極限的類別樣板是 std::numeric____。

explanation.zh-Hant: std::numeric_limits<T>::max() 與 ::min() 會回傳 T 的極限值。

questions.explanation: std::numeric_limits<T>::max() and ::min() report the range of T.

questions.prompt: Why should floating-point values usually be compared with a tolerance instead of `==`?

prompt.zh-Hant: 為何浮點數通常應以容差比較，而不是直接用 `==`？

model.zh-Hant: 浮點數以有限位元近似表示，運算過程會累積捨入誤差，兩個數學上相等的值在記憶體中可能相差極小量。應以 `std::abs(a - b) < epsilon` 之類的容差判斷，epsilon 依數量級選取。

explanation.zh-Hant: 關鍵是浮點表示與運算的捨入誤差，而非數學上的精確相等。

answer.model: Floating-point values are stored as finite-precision approximations, and arithmetic accumulates rounding error. Two mathematically equal results can differ by a tiny amount in memory, so compare with a tolerance such as `std::abs(a - b) < epsilon`, choosing epsilon for the expected magnitude.

questions.explanation: The issue is representation and rounding error, not mathematical equality.
